markers.desc: The dragon's roar echoes, and the whirling clouds twirl. The sea opens its maws, as the dead Arbor sprouts. Hindered by the seal, the Ambrosial Arbor's roots curl into a dragon-shaped wood gall at this place, and no longer grows.
markers.descRu: Раздаётся рёв дракона, и кружатся облака. И разверзается синяя пучина, когда оживают мёртвые ростки. Корни Древа амброзии, скованные печатью, образуют форму дракона и перестают расти.

markers.desc: The enormous dragon palace of the Vidyadhara is buried in the seafloor valley, like how the past is buried by time.
markers.descRu: Огромный драконий дворец видьядхара погребён в глубинах морского ущелья, словно прошлое, погребённое временем.

markers.desc: A Vidyadhara High Elder from millennia ago commanded the waters of the ancient sea to engulf the Arbor's roots. The Luofu's Vidyadhara had been shouldering the duty of keeping watch over the Ambrosial Arbor ever since.
markers.descRu: Тысячи лет назад один Верховный старейшина направил воды древнего моря скрыть корни Древа амброзии. С тех самых пор видьядхара возложили на себя бремя присматривать за Древом.

markers.desc: The Alchemy Commission once demonstrated the way of immortality. However, as the Ambrosial Arbor was discarded, the commission's social position plummeted and no longer sways the balance of power in Xianzhou.
markers.descRu: Комиссия по алхимии однажды показала путь к бессмертию. Однако, поскольку Древо амброзии было разрушено, Комиссия утратила былую власть и больше не может повлиять на баланс сил Сяньчжоу.

markers.desc: A longstanding Xianzhou prison system jointly established by the Xianzhou people and the Vidyadhara. Devoted to suppressing evildoers and those who violate the law, namely repeat offenders and abominations.
markers.descRu: Тюремная система Сяньчжоу, разработанная много веков назад сяньчжоуцами и видьядхара для особо опасных преступников и Мерзости.

lines.en: Various freight containers are placed on the assembly line. Adjust the position of the freight containers to fill gaps in the road or remove obstacles to open new passages.
lines.ru: На сборочной линии размещаются различные грузовые контейнеры. Отрегулируйте положение грузовых контейнеров, чтобы заполнить брешь на пути или убрать препятствия и открыть новые проходы.

lines.en: Manual operation can only make minor adjustments to the freight containers on the assembly line. The lights on the control panel indicate the range of the adjustments that can be performed.
lines.ru: Ручное управление может внести лишь незначительные коррективы в грузовые контейнеры на сборочной линии. Индикаторы на панели управления указывают диапазон незначительных регулировок, которые могут быть выполнены.

lines.en: An ingenium dog crafted by the Artisanship Commission. Use its Locality Probe feature to find suspicious odors and traces.
lines.ru: Механическая собака, созданная Комиссией по ремёслам. Используйте его функцию зондирования области для обнаружения подозрительных запахов и следов.

lines.en: The jade abacus substrate system developed by the Artisanship Commission. Move the computing modules with subroutines stored in them to bases with corresponding patterns, so that the substrate can function normally.
lines.ru: Система подложек для нефритовых счётов, разработанная Комиссией по ремёслам. Переместите вычислительные модули с хранящимися в них подпрограммами на базы с соответствующими шаблонами, чтобы подложка могла нормально функционировать.

lines.en: Fixed modules cannot be moved and will cause the nearby computing modules to spring back. Use this trick to adjust the position of computing modules.
lines.ru: Неподвижные модули не могут быть перемещены. Они отталкивают близлежащие вычислительные модули. Используйте этот трюк, чтобы настроить положение вычислительных модулей.

lines.en: Teleportation modules will teleport the computing modules above it to the other end.
lines.ru: Модули телепортации будут телепортировать вычислительные модули на них на другой конец.

lines.en: Shifting Screen is a short-distance teleportation device of the Artisanship Commission that allows characters to teleport between two spatial coordinates.
lines.ru: Ширма телепортации - это устройство для телепортации на короткие расстояния, созданное Комиссией по ремёслам и позволяющее персонажам телепортироваться между двумя пространственными координатами.

lines.en: Some Shifting Screens can be rotated and aligned to another Shifting Screen, allowing characters to teleport between them.
lines.ru: Некоторые ширмы телепортации можно поворачивать и выравнивать с другой ширмой телепортации, позволяя персонажам телепортироваться между ними.

lines.en: Mutare Magnus is a large-scale jade abacus calculation terminal used to calculate shipping routes and predict future events. To activate the base terminal, simply move the layout on the ground to match the pattern with the shape that is shown.
lines.ru: Всеобъемлющее предсказание - это огромный нефритовый счётный терминал, используемый для расчёта маршрутов и предсказания будущего. Переместите его макет на землю, повторив шаблон матрицы по указанной форме, и запустите базовые терминалы.

lines.en: Ambrosial Arbor's branches can be found blocking the path. Use the Artisanship Commission's energy conduction device to destroy all the entangled Ambrosial Arbor's coils at the same time.
lines.ru: Используйте устройство для передачи энергии, созданное Комиссией по ремёслам, чтобы уничтожить все узлы Древа амброзии одновременно и сломать ветви Древа амброзии, преграждающие путь.

lines.en: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.
lines.ru: Используйте триггер, чтобы высвободить энергию хелиоби, и поверните приёмник, чтобы отрегулировать направление проводимости энергии хелиоби.

lines.en: The Ambrosial Arbor coils need to be destroyed at the same time or they will grow back rapidly.
lines.ru: Узлы Древа амброзии нужно уничтожить одновременно, иначе они быстро вырастут заново.

lines.en: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.
lines.ru: Церемониальный светильник, оставленный видьядхара, таящий в себе силу запечатывания расы видьядхара.

lines.en: By lighting them up in a specific sequence, the corresponding seals in Scalegorge Waterscape can be removed.
lines.ru: Зажигая их в определённом порядке, можно снять печати Чешуйчатого ущелья.

Mara-Struck Soldier.ability: Wind Shear to Player; DoT to Player; Revive

desc.en: Soldiers of the Xianzhou who somehow fell into madness. Their bodies continue to grow and mutate and have long lost their humanoid form. It is said that the long-lived Xianzhou natives would eventually be stricken with mara.
desc.ru: Солдаты Сяньчжоу, которые каким-то образом впали в безумие. Их тела продолжают расти и видоизменяться и уже давно потеряли человеческий облик. Говорят, что долгожители Сяньчжоу будут поражены Марой.

skills.desc: Deals minor Wind DMG (200% ATK) to a single target, with a high chance to inflict Wind Shear (Applies 2 Stacks, 50% ATK DoT Per Stack, 3 Turns).
Upon receiving a killing blow, restores a certain amount of HP (50% Max HP). This effect does not have a time limit but can be dispelled. This effect can only trigger 1 time per battle.
Deals minor Wind DMG (200% ATK) to a single target, with a high chance to inflict Wind Shear (Applies 2 Stacks, 50% ATK DoT Per Stack, 3 Turns).

Disciples of Sanctus Medicus: Shape Shif.ability: Summoner; Healing to Self; HP Consumption

desc.en: A cultivator who longs to revive the ancient mysteries of the Abundance, and to guide the Xianzhou natives back on the liberating path of immortality. / Now, their wish has been fulfilled. Gifted by the power of the ancient miracle and using it as both weapon and armor, they managed to touch on the secret of immortality.
desc.ru: Культиватор, который жаждал возродить тайные искусства Изобилия и снова направить Сяньчжоу на освобождающий путь небожителей. И вот желание исполнилось. Одарённый силой древних чудес, которые использовались и как оружие, и как доспехи, он смог прикоснуться к тайнам бессмертия.

notes: Thudding Calamity is a multi-hit attack and will trigger the healing effect of Draining Hit a total of 8 times.
Punishing Bolts will trigger the healing effect of Draining Hit 1–3 times depending on the amount of targets hit.
Summoned Mara-Struck Soldiers will die when the Shape Shifter dies.

skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG (350% ATK) to a single target.
Deals Lightning DMG (300% ATK) to a single target and units adjacent to the target.
Deals massive Lightning DMG (500% ATK) to a single target.
Consumes HP (10% Max HP) to summon Mara-Struck Soldiers (2)
When there are other friendly units with Rebirth on the field, they have Draining Hit. When hitting a target, they will restore HP (2.5% Max HP).
Deals Lightning DMG (350% ATK) to a single target.

Disciples of Sanctus Medicus: Internal A.en: Disciples of Sanctus Medicus: Internal Alchemist

desc.en: A member of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, the secret sect that hid within the Xianzhou Luofu. / With medicine, purify the heart. With elixir, transform one's body. They long to revive the ancient mysteries of the Abundance, hoping to spur Xianzhou natives towards their next stage of evolution.
desc.ru: Один из Учеников Санктус Медикус, тайной группировки, затаившейся на Лофу Сяньчжоу. К просветлению через медицину, к очищению через эликсир. Они стремятся возродить утраченные искусства Изобилия, надеясь подтолкнуть Сяньчжоу к следующему этапу эволюции.

skills.desc: Inflicts a single target with Spur of Thunderwoe.
Deals minor Lightning DMG (250% ATK) to a single target.

Upon receiving a killing blow, this unit deals Lightning DMG (450% ATK) to any targets that were inflicted with Spur of Thunderwoe by them. Afterward, Spur of Thunderwoe on these targets will be removed.
Inflicts a single target with Spur of Thunderwoe.

desc.en: A member of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, the secret organization that had lain hidden in the Xianzhou Luofu. / They pursue cultivation using tools and merge with them. They long to revive the lost secrets of Abundance, hoping to spur Xianzhou natives toward their next stage of evolution.
desc.ru: Один из Учеников Санктус Медикус, тайной группировки, затаившейся на Лофу Сяньчжоу. Они стремятся к самосовершенствованию, сливаясь со своим орудием в единое целое. Они стремятся возродить утраченные искусства Изобилия, надеясь подтолкнуть Сяньчжоу к следующему этапу эволюции.

desc.en: Member of the ground patrol division of the The Xianzhou Luofu Cloud Knights. Wearing a light set of silver armor and with a Devastator Glaive in hand, they are in charge of maintaining order in every delve.

Diting.profile: A Diting is a type of Ingenium dog created by the Artisanship Commission. They are highly intelligent: some of them able to communicate with people, analyze the entire archives of the Artisanship Commission and customize their own staff profile picture, and even play video games like Aetherium Wars. Ditings have all five senses of the foxian race and "takes them to another level." They are mainly used as forensic equipment by the Realm-Keeping Commission via the Locality Probe feature. Tingyun borrows one to help assist with the Luofu's manhunt for Kafka, Yanqing uses one to track Blade and record the footage, and the Trailblazer borrows one to track the Faunus Red Sheep released by the Unshackled. Ditings are also heavily associated with Guinaifen. Her splash art features multiple Ditings, and her Ultimate, {{Skill|Watch This Showstopper|20|nobr=1}}, summons them to ignite firecrackers. Both her phone case and avatar on Ghostly Grove also feature a Diting. During Saga of Primaveral Blade, Ditings are used to train the Strength of March 7th (The Hunt) via standing on her arms. When she uses her Ultimate, {{Skill|March 7th, the Apex Heroine|20|nobr=1}}, Ditings appear in her flashback of the training.

Master Gongshu.profile: Master Gongshu is a Master Artisan of the Luofu Artisanship Commission and its Acting Master during Zhu Lun's absence.

Yanming.profile: Yanming is the Amicassador of the Sky-Faring Commission's Celestial Guild and "half a Maritime Trade Officer." His previous job titles include trade ship captain and business professor in a lyceum.

Qingzu.profile: She holds the position of Chief Counselor for the Divine Foresight.

Dan Shu.profile: {{See Also|Dan Shu's Diary}} Dan Shu is a Xianzhou Native and lifelong resident of the Luofu. She is irreversibly blind, and labels herself as well as others with such afflictions as "Incomplete Ones." As a healer of the Alchemy Commission, she was considered exemplary and eventually became Chief Alchemist. After the banishment of the former Commission head Yunhua, she assumed practical leadership of the Commission.

Phantylia.profile: Phantylia belongs to a class of particularly powerful heliobi that have an especially strong sense of self-awareness. Such heliobi are made up of several heliobi who have resolved their differences and fused into an indissoluble whole. Weaker heliobi fear such beings, as getting too close to them will cause them to be absorbed by the more powerful heliobus and permanently lose their sense of self, essentially leading to their death. Phantylia has stolen many bodies in an attempt to obtain an indestructible body, but knows that it is impossible. She describes herself as a flame of The Blemished One, and that if the fuel ever runs out, the fire will also be extinguished. She finds pleasure in causing the self-destruction of mortals, and favors causing destruction through internal collapse rather than direct attacks. Asat Pramad claims that Phantylia detests stubborn minds and, consequently, guests she fails to seize, abhorring the taste of human courage. He also says that her greatest weakness is her insatiable greed, always wanting everything at once.

Mengming.profile: She is the current owner and operator of the Sleepless Earl teahouse. The Sleepless Earl was initially opened by Mengming's parents, and the teahouse has been on business on Starwatcher Avenue for over 400 years. While her parents were traveling together, she was entrusted with taking over the family business, with her dad wanting to test her abilities. She serves items in exchange for Credit.

Yancui.profile: Yancui is the Cloudbanner Meteor Fist's chief disciple and an ex-service Cloud Knights veteran. She operates the Spices Supreme Shop, offering items in exchange for Credits. She is known for cooking dishes with the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters she defeats with her martial arts.

Back'n.profile: He shares the title of "Crosstalk Lover" with Forth.

Forth.profile: He shares the title of "Crosstalk Lover" with Back'n.

Xiaoyu.profile: Xiayou is a blind girl whose parents died in Denizens of Abundance Wars and has since been helped by Dan Shu. <!--

Awei.profile: Awei is an apprentice of Master Gongshu. <!--

Yuluo.profile: Yuluo is Chief Alchemist of Xianzhou Luofu's Alchemy Commission and was the temporary acting head of the Luofu Alchemy Commission between former Chief Alchemist Dan Shu's death and the appointment of the new Luofu Cauldron Master, Lingsha.

Jingyan.profile: When Jingyan was young, she read The Angler Mystery and became a fan. She used to dream about working in the Alchemy Commission like the Angler. Jingyan's life was once saved by the then Cloud Knight Dahao. Her admiration of him led her to join the Cloud Knights herself, and she worked herself to the bone and eventually joined his elite squad. Later on, General Jing Yuan was worried about Dahao getting struck with early-onset mara due to his combat experience and hoped he could accept a sinecure position as a Realm-Keeping Commission official in the Exalting Sanctum — and keep him from the pains of life and death. Jingyan applied for a transfer as she thought it would be great to help out Dahao, and Jing Yuan let her come here and be a minor officer at the Realm-Keeping Commission. She considered changing her career to chase her old dream once. However, the longer she stays in her current job, the more she understands its purpose. Her job of fighting crime, helping the weak, solving the problems no one wants to touch, etc. has become a satisfying feeling.

Songyan.profile: Songyan originally hailed from the General Affairs Office on the Xianzhou Luofu, holding an elite position in their ranks. Songyan's strong sense of responsibility led to him being deemed the "Realm-Keeping Commission's Most Intelligent." When Songyan's investments fell through, he ended up "paying a heavy price" that caused his motivation to severely deteriorate. This incident eventually led to his transfer to the Commission Chancery under Official Dahao, who believes he will be ready again with more time. Songyan, however, sees this transfer as more of an excuse to slack off, reasoning that "with little power comes little responsibility." During the Astral Express' first visit to the Xianzhou Luofu, Songyan and his colleagues were deployed to the Exalting Sanctum after reports of issues near the meridian pin. They were responsible for cordoning off the area to protect civilians, being present for over twelve hours before the Trailblazer, March 7th and Welt arrived.

Guangda.profile: Guangda is an orderly who has been working for the Realm-Keeping Commission for 400 years.

Jinwen.profile: Jinwen is a dispirited healer in the Alchemy Commission who is several centuries old. She became disheartened after many healers were revealed to be traitors working with the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, including her late apprentice, who died in battle.

Mr. Xiyan.image: Gamescom Exhibition — "Tales of the Luofu- A New Chapter" - Honkai- Star Rail
Mr. Xiyan.profile: Mr. Xiyan is a storyteller for the Sleepless Earl aboard the Xianzhou Luofu and an old friend of Mengming's parents. He also assists the latter, who is the current owner of the teahouse, after the Sleepless Earl was left in her hands by her parents as a kind of a test. Mr. Xiyan was asked by Mengming's parents to help her run the business from behind the scenes, giving her a little guidance or two. He studied at the Royal Academy on The Xianzhou Yaoqing and is a professional playwright by trade. He is also the manager of Spare Time Book Shop in Exalting Sanctum but doesn't show up very often. Prior to the events of Youci's Clever Decor, he obtained a pet bird named Youci.

Qingyue.profile: She is the owner of the Iridescent Parlor, a fashion store that sells jewelry incorporating jade abaci.

Pawnbroker Handian.profile: He operates the Jeweler's Pagoda World Shop, offering items in exchange for Strales.

Salesby.profile: He operates the Grocery Stand Shop, offering items in exchange for Credits.

Yubie.profile: Yubie was the first High Elder to accept the mission of subduing the Ambrosial Arbor. He moved the waters of Scalegorge Waterscape and used cloudhymn to seal the Arbor's roots underwater. Though he was successful and its activity subsided, many Vidyadhara were unhappy with this decision and considered it blasphemous to use the sacred realm from their home. He was reported to the Preceptors, and implied to have been stripped of his title and powers as punishment. However, others still lauded him as a hero for pacifying the Six Charioteers and creating an era of peace. Preceptor Sutuan led a commission of artisans to erect the Dragonvista Rain Hall and the statue of the High Elder in commemoration of him.

Dan Feng.image: Character Reference Sheet Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae 2.jpg
Dan Feng.profile: Both a renowned member of the Xianzhou Alliance's High-Cloud Quintet and the High Elder of the Luofu's Vidyadhara, Dan Feng was an important figure within the Alliance. Due to circumstances that led to the Quintet's dissolution, he was charged guilty of one of the Xianzhou's "ten unpardonable sins" and sentenced to imprisonment in the Shackling Prison, where he was forced to undergo hatching rebirth and eternal banishment.
